column1: # Models left out on purpose after review (converted-maps policy final pass, 2026-11-17). Not a gap and not a placeholder:
# each row says why no stand-in is placed. The licence block names these `dropped`; `bsp.py standins` counts them in the
# dropped tier. Every row must name a reason; no-omission mode (`regen --no-omit`) ignores this table.
# model path regex (searched in the lower-case path)

column3: a non-player figure: our games spawn their own players and NPCs, and a still figure reads as a stuck player
a citizen or corpse figure: our games spawn their own players and NPCs
an NPC creature or its ragdoll part: NPCs are the game's, not the map's
an NPC creature: NPCs are the game's, not the map's
a character cosmetic shown on its own: it belongs to a character model, not to the map
an engine shader test model (a cloaked figure), not scenery
a glow or light-shaft effect: the map's own lights and our engine's fog and glow draw it
a spinning portal effect parented to a rotator: an effect, not a prop
an editor marker for a speech point, invisible in the original game
cloud cards in the 3D sky room: our sky draws the clouds
a distant tower in the 3D sky room: sky dressing, drawn by our sky
distant houses standing only in a 3D sky room (hs_restaurant): sky dressing, drawn by our sky
